name: Automatica Ford (building site)

sources.label: OSM w39348916 · building=construction, historic=building, start_date=1938, building:levels=2
District dossier: Automatica Ford site, scaffold mesh behind a navy hoarding
Fidelity pass round 3 (2b1a251), not yet published when captured

improvements: The Automatica Ford building site is drawn as what the street shows: white scaffold netting on a grid of scaffold tubes behind a dark navy site hoarding along Calea Floreasca, on the mapped outline and at the two mapped storeys. It was a finished white two-storey hall.
remainingGaps: Storey height (10 m for two storeys of a 1938 industrial hall), hoarding height and tube spacing are estimates; the hoarding stands on the mapped outline (its real line on the pavement is not mapped); no hoarding text is drawn (the banners are advertising).
OSM check_date 2026-04-08 still has the site under construction; the panorama is from May 2024 (viewed only).
